title: Open subspaces as representable open subfunctors
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $F$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. An open subspace of $F$ is a subfunctor $A\subseteq F$ [def-pc-subfunctor] whose inclusion is representable by open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]: for every $S$-scheme $T$ and $h_T\to F$, the pullback $h_T\times_F A$ is represented by an open subscheme of $T$. The order on open subspaces is inclusion of subfunctors. Such a subfunctor is automatically an algebraic space.
